title: Wantit
description: A small mod that add cool additions to minecraft
body:
The mod is based in cool additions to minecraft

some things in the mod:

new foods, that let you have potion effects!!
New tools like the paxel and new weapons
Quality of life recipes
A Cobblestone generator
New advancements based on the mod
New decoractives blocks
In the future i will add more things

[curseforge page](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/wantit)
